name: Tammy Duckworth

issue_poll.name: Emerson College/WGN-TV/The Hill Illinois poll, Oct 20–24, 2022; Pew Research Center national survey, Oct 10–16, 2022
issue_poll.note: Ranks 1–4 from Emerson's Illinois most-important-issue question (economy 39%, threats to democracy 18%, abortion access 12%, crime 9%); only these four were published, and 'threats to democracy' is mapped to elections/voting. Ranks 5–10 are the next issues in Pew's national 'very important' list (https://www.pewresearch.org/wp-content/uploads/sites/20/2022/10/PP_2022.10.20_midterms-economy_REPORT.pdf), skipping items already covered.

issues.position: Pass the Gas Price Gouging Prevention Act
issues.note: No Senate floor vote on a gas price-gouging ban this term.

issues.position: Restore the Voting Rights Act; expand early and mail voting
Codify Roe v. Wade in federal law; repeal the Hyde Amendment

votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed

issues.position: Called Chicago crime a mayoral issue; no specific federal plan
Tuition-free community college; keep one-time student loan forgiveness

votes.bill_title: Disapproval of student loan debt relief
votes.question: On passage

issues.note: Loan-forgiveness defense from the Oct 2022 forum: https://news.wttw.com/2022/10/27/tammy-duckworth-kathy-salvi-spar-only-joint-forum-illinois-us-senate-race

issues.position: Cap insulin at $35 a month, including private plans
issues.note: No Senate floor vote on a private-insurance insulin cap this term.

issues.position: Support clean energy and cut carbon emissions (direction only)
Ban assault weapons and high-capacity magazines; red-flag laws
issues.note: No recorded Senate floor vote on these measures this term.

issues.position: More border security plus path to citizenship; oppose border wall

votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed

issues.note: Citizenship path never got a floor vote; rated on the border-security part.

caveats: Emerson published only its top four Illinois issues; ranks 5–10 come from national Pew polling.
Elections rated on the SAVE America Act votes; the Voting Rights Act restoration she backed got no floor vote this term.
Health care position rests on her March 2022 Senate release joining the insulin-cap bill; no campaign-specific health plan found.
